dem.dataset: Original Product Resolution (OPR) Digital Elevation Model (DEM)
dem.source: USGS 3DEP Original Product Resolution DEM, CA_LosAngeles_B23 (published 2025-06-13)
dem.licence: USGS public domain. Access constraints: "None." Credit: "Acknowledgement of the USGS 3D Elevation Program would be appreciated in products derived from these data."

canopy.why: Miami's shares (0.59 and 0.15) grow a forest over the chaparral, the parks and the cemeteries; Los Angeles's tree canopy is about a fifth of the city, and chaparral in a climate of summer drought and fire stays shrubland

world.sea_source: No sea in the frame; heights are over mean sea level at NOAA CO-OPS station 9410840 Santa Monica, 16 km south-west, 1983-2001 epoch: 1.594 m above station datum, NAVD88 at 0.802

places.name: Griffith Park
places.why: a city park of 17 km2 with the Observatory and the Greek Theatre in it, mapped as a park, not a neighbourhood

places.name: West Hollywood
places.why: a city of its own, which OpenStreetMap tags place=city, so the quarter-and-neighbourhood seeds leave it to Fairfax

drop: Melrose Hill Historic Preservation Overlay Zone

obelisks.name: Griffith Observatory
obelisks.why: the observatory's ridge holds no ground level to 4 m for a deck within 500 m (by its parking the deck would have been cut 46 m into the hill): on the Roosevelt golf course below the Greek Theatre, 700 m east and 115 m down, broadside to the basin; 28 m, as a larger deck lies 400 m further off

obelisks.name: Hollywood and Highland
obelisks.why: on Hollywood High School's field a block south of the Boulevard, the nearest open ground: a tower of light over the marquees, as a premiere's searchlights

obelisks.name: Lake Hollywood Park
obelisks.why: on the park's lawn under the Hollywood Sign, the only level ground of the hill (an 18 m deck), the reservoir below it, broadside to Hollywood

future.spans_why: None: no bridge in the frame crosses water
future.wrecks_why: None: no water in the frame holds a hull
